supersedesFinding: The no-confirmed-defect conclusion in composition-art-review.json missed Edda’s service-counter arm anatomy. This report supersedes that acceptance without rewriting the historical snapshot.
reviewer: AI development visual inspection; user-approved participation proxy
method: Reopened all 33 existing native-pixel primary inspection sheets; did not rely on earlier acceptance notes.
Traced visible shoulder–arm–elbow–wrist–hand paths rather than counting hand shapes alone. Reopened Edda individually.
Additional native-pixel torso/hand crops for 22 character paintings across six inspection sheets. Crops are inspection-only, not delivery edits.
Viewed corrected master and all three delivery sizes individually.

Viewed all 165 responsive/preview derivatives across six contact sheets; compared them to resized current primary pixels and checked global delivery hashes. Pixel differences are lossy JPEG diagnostics, not an anatomy score.
limits: AI review can miss visual defects, as the preceding review did. Tiny background figures and obscured fingers cannot establish fine anatomy. Hash tests enforce reviewed delivery identity, not artistic correctness or independent acceptance.
